components.name: Living Wordmark Signal
components.description: A calibrated field framing the persistent Pr and c anchors around the resolving word.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; width: 420px; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 0; border-block: 1px solid var(--border, #2a3350); background: var(--bg, #0a0e1a); color: var(--text, #edeff5); } .ds-wordmark::after { position: absolute; inset: 50% 0 auto; height: 1px; background: var(--border, #2a3350); content: ""; } .ds-wordmark strong { position: relative; z-index: 1; color: var(--accent, #00d9ff); font: 500 56px/0.9 Space Grotesk, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.04em; } .ds-anchor { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: grid; min-width: 28px; min-height: 28px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a3350); background: var(--bg, #0a0e1a); color: var(--text-muted, #8b93ab); font: 400 10px/1 JetBrains Mono, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-anchor-end { color: var(--accent, #00d9ff); }

narrative.overview:
The visual world behaves like a precise architectural drawing brought to life. A near-black field holds off-white language, measured slate construction lines and one scarce cyan signal. The work feels calm, technically credible and deliberately unfinished at the edges, as if every visible decision belongs to a larger system.

The company method is the proof. Type, route geometry, registration marks and written constraints replace stock imagery and invented evidence. Framer-level craft is a quality reference, but the composition, P/Z geometry and living wordmark remain recognizably Prizic.
keyCharacteristics: Asymmetric editorial layouts with a 5/7 desktop rhythm
Flat fields separated by rules instead of decorative shadows
Sparse cyan reserved for routes, punctuation and decisive actions
Authored P/Z geometry, measurements and calibration marks
Motion that explains sequence once, then becomes still
Plain language and visible limits instead of unsupported claims

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Cyan is the only chromatic accent and should occupy roughly five percent or less of a viewport.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from tone, borders and overlap. Do not introduce gradients, glows, glass effects or decorative shadows.

rules.name: The Left Edge Rule
rules.body: Paragraphs remain left aligned. Hierarchy comes from scale and position, not centered marketing copy.

rules.name: The Mono Is Metadata Rule
rules.body: Monospace type labels the system; it does not carry headlines or paragraphs.

rules.name: The No Decoration Depth Rule
rules.body: A new shadow is a design-system change, not a convenient way to make a surface visible.

dos: Do let typography, authored geometry and documented method carry the company story.
Do keep cyan scarce and attach it to meaning, movement or action.
Do preserve the static P/Z mark, visible Pr and c anchors, one-time sequence and settled final state.
Do use approved assets from the authoritative Prizic logo source and runtime copies from public/brand/.
Do keep navigation, content and the final reduced-motion state understandable without JavaScript.
Do add real company evidence only after it is approved and represented accurately.
donts: Don't use gradients, glows, glassmorphism, stock imagery, AI-generated people, looping logos, marquees or parallax fields.
Don't turn the blueprint into a dashboard, workflow screenshot or generic technology illustration.
Don't fabricate projects, customers, logos, testimonials, reviews, prices or performance metrics.
Don't publish dental, clinic or booking content in this corporate release.
Don't imply a launched product, large team, legal status or partnership terms that have not been confirmed.
Don't replace the 5/7 hierarchy with repeated equal cards or centered marketing sections.
